en: An old black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a Baroque or late Renaissance building with ornate stonework. In the foreground there is a balustraded stone terrace partly covered with climbing plants and trees. Behind it stands a two‑storey mansion or palace wing with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows. At the center is an elaborate arched entrance with sculpted decoration and a balcony, suggesting a historic European residence or palace complex. The lower edge of the image is damaged, and handwritten numbers are visible along the bottom border.
